name: cyberine-worktree
description: WorktreeCreate hook for Claude Code: every agent or EnterWorktree worktree goes to <main repository>/.claude/worktrees/<name> on branch worktree/<name>, based on the spawning session's HEAD, and a nested spawn from a linked worktree still lands under the main repository. Replaces Claude Code's own worktree creation while installed. Warns at session start when another WorktreeCreate hook is configured.
